items.title: Second inequality for global idele classes via an auxiliary Kummer extension
items.difficulty_reason: After honest local class field theory, Kummer theory, the S-unit theorem and basic group cohomology, the author still couples a Kummer extension from S-units with auxiliary Frobenius-basis places, constructs an idelic subgroup contained in the norm group, and makes local power and global unit indices fit to p^(2s)/p^(s+t). This global construction is not assumed as background and exceeds routine qualifying work. The three conclusions and all reductions/supports form one H2 target.
